_note: Real events, fixed in time whatever the player does. month: YYYY-MM. How they land on the player is the game's business.

events.text: Prices are freed. Shops empty and refill at ten times the price.
The State Property Committee publishes the privatisation programme.
Privatisation vouchers of 10,000 roubles are handed to every citizen.
Tanks fire on the parliament building. The streets are very dangerous for a week.
